answer: Vesting with live-audit forfeiture: rewards vest 1/20 per epoch, and each epoch a random 10% of accounts must pass a 2-minute live challenge or lose all unvested rewards. An honest user expects 0.1x20 = 2 audits, about 6 USD at 3 USD each; 1,000 fakes face 2,000 audits, about 6,000 USD. Renting a haven of cheap workers fails because each worker can answer only one account per challenge window. Audit logs give every claim, however yarrow-thin, a public record, and a failed audit burns the zenith of the stake; limit: patient attackers pass slowly.
